questions.question: Holnap korán _______ felkelni.
questions.translate: I will get up early tomorrow.

questions.question: Reggel 7-kor Péter _______ elindulni otthonról.
questions.translate: Péter will leave home at 7 in the morning.

questions.question: A diákok nemsokára _______ vizsgázni.
questions.translate: The students will take an exam soon.

questions.question: Mi este otthon _______ vacsorázni.
questions.translate: We will have dinner at home tonight.

questions.question: Te holnap iskolába _______ menni?
questions.translate: Will you go to school tomorrow?

questions.question: Ők holnap este filmet _______ nézni.
questions.translate: They will watch a movie tomorrow night.

questions.question: A munka után én még sokáig _______ dolgozni.
questions.translate: After work, I will continue working for a long time.

questions.question: Jövő héten sokat _______ tanulni.
questions.translate: We will study a lot next week.
